first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus a Belfast City 2006 dataset-specific CRS declaration and archive-internal DTM tile filenames. This unused official Spatial NI Data Preparation Guide window confirms that Spatial NI accepts Irish Grid TM65 (EPSG:29902), Irish Grid TM75 (EPSG:29903), and Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157), but it is a generic data-supply standard and does not identify which projection applies to the Belfast City 2006 LiDAR archive or expose any archive-internal tile filename; no CRS is assigned to the Belfast dataset and no tile/parcel binding is fabricated.
